devdoc.details: Implementation of a strategy to get yields from farming LP Pools in PancakeSwap. PancakeSwap is an automated market maker (“AMM”) that allows two tokens to be exchanged on the Binance Smart Chain. It is fast, cheap, and allows anyone to participate. PancakeSwap is aiming to be the #1 liquidity provider on BSC. This strategy simply deposits whatever funds it receives from the vault into the selected MasterFarmer pool. CAKE rewards from providing liquidity are farmed every few minutes, sold and split 50/50. The corresponding pair of assets are bought and more liquidity is added to the MasterFarmer pool. This strat is currently compatible with all LP pools.

balanceOf().details: Function to calculate the total underlaying {lpPair} held by the strat. It takes into account both the funds in hand, as the funds allocated in the MasterFarmer.

balanceOfLpPair().details: It calculates how much {lpPair} the contract holds.

balanceOfPool().details: It calculates how much {lpPair} the strategy has allocated in the MasterFarmer

constructor.details: Initializes the strategy with the token to maximize.

deposit().details: Function that puts the funds to work. It gets called whenever someone deposits in the strategy's vault contract. It deposits {lpPair} in the masterFarmer to farm {bscx}

harvest().details: Core function of the strat, in charge of collecting and re-investing rewards. 1. It claims rewards from the MasterFarmer. 2. It charges the system fees to simplify the split. 3. It swaps the {bscx} token for {lpToken0} & {lpToken1} 4. Adds more liquidity to the pool. 5. It deposits the new LP tokens.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

panic().details: Pauses deposits. Withdraws all funds from the MasterFarmer, leaving rewards behind

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdraw(uint256).details: Withdraws funds and sents them back to the vault. It withdraws {lpPair} from the MasterFarmer. The available {lpPair} minus fees is returned to the vault.

REWARDS_FEE.details: Distribution of fees earned. This allocations relative to the % implemented on doSplit(). Current implementation separates 6% for fees. {REWARDS_FEE} - 4% goes to JETS/FUEL holders through the JETS contract. {CALL_FEE} - 0.5% goes to whoever executes the harvest function as gas subsidy. {TREASURY_FEE} - 1.5% goes to the treasury. {MAX_FEE} - Aux const used to safely calc the correct amounts. {WITHDRAWAL_FEE} - Fee taxed when a user withdraws funds. 50 === 0.5% fee. {WITHDRAWAL_MAX} - Aux const used to safely calc the correct amounts..

bscxToWbnbRoute.details: Routes we take to swap tokens using PancakeSwap. {bscxToWbnbRoute} - Route we take to get from {bscx} into {wbnb}. {wbnbToFuelRoute} - Route we take to get from {wbnb} into {fuel}. {bscxToLp0Route} - Route we take to get from {bscx} into {lpToken0}. {bscxToLp1Route} - Route we take to get from {bscx} into {lpToken1}.

rewards.details: Jetfuel Contracts: {rewards} - Reward pool where the strategy fee earnings will go. {treasury} - Address of the Jetfuel Finance treasury {vault} - Address of the vault that controls the strategy's funds.

unirouter.details: Third Party Contracts: {unirouter} - PancakeSwap BSCEX unirouter {masterFarmer} - BSCXMasterFarmer contract {poolId} - masterFarmer pool id

wbnb.details: Tokens Used: {wbnb} - Required for liquidity routing when doing swaps. {bscx} - Token generated by staking our funds. In this case it's the CAKEs token. {fuel} - Jetfuel Finance token, used to send funds to the JETS contract. {lpPair} - Token that the strategy maximizes. The same token that users deposit in the vault. {lpToken0, lpToken1} - Tokens that the strategy maximizes. IPancakePair tokens
